## Overview

```{python}
#| include: false
# Season count and years come from the data the notebook pulled.
import pandas as pd

seasons = pd.read_csv("pl_data_cache.csv")["Season"]
n_seasons = len(seasons)
first_year = int(seasons.iloc[0][:4])
last_year = int(seasons.iloc[-1][:4]) + 1
```

An analysis of how the gap between Premier League champions
and relegation survivors has grown over `{python} n_seasons` seasons,
from `{python} first_year` to `{python} last_year`.

## Key Findings

- Title-winning points trend upward (+0.25 pts/season)
- Relegation survival points are flat or declining
- The gap has grown from ~35-50 pts to 50-65 pts
